release_notes:
1. Exact ROUND_HALF_UP Commercial Price Parity: Aligns data layer product pricing (price and ecommerce.value) with customer-facing storefront display (e.g. 25.99 € with 50% discount = exactly 13.00 € under standard European commercial half-up rounding).
2. Backend-Driven Pricing Resolution: Replaces premature intermediate net pre-tax truncation with customer-facing retail gross reduction math.
3. Universal Dynamic Calculation: Applies across all product combinations, specific price rules, catalog discounts, and currencies.
4. Robust Floating Point Rounding: Integrated epsilon-protected ROUND_HALF_UP decimal engine across PHP backend and JavaScript data layer core.
